opinions.text:
C. A. 9th Cir. [Cer-tiorari granted, 567 U. S. 933.] Motion of petitioners in No. 11-338 for leave to file supplemental brief after argument granted. Other parties to these eases and the Solicitor General may file supplemental briefs, not to exceed 3,000 words each, addressing the effect of the Environmental Protection Agency’s amendment to its stormwater-discharge rule on or before Tuesday, January 22, 2013.
Justice Breyer took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
